meta.note: Certified bounds on the Grothendieck constant of order 3 (real, 3-dimensional vectors). K_G(3) = 1/v_c where v_c is the critical visibility of the two-qubit Werner state under projective measurements (Acin-Gisin-Toner 2006). No later K_G(3) bound was found in a web search on 2026-10-14 (2409.03739v4, Oct 2026, still cites 2302.04721 for the upper bound).

upper.exact_note: phase-2 best certified bound (board #241, cg): K_G(3) <= 1.4494177506 (verifier output, rounded up), Werner v >= 0.6899322156; 721 directions (rad721_a: icosahedral geodesic ico_m721_geo with a small per-orbit radius/position deformation), lam = 0.6922221022, eta^2 = 0.996691977 (exact), K = 19318 orbit-atoms x 60 rotations x transpose.
upper.source: this project, phase 2 (2026-10-15): results/RESULTS.md, results/certificates/KG3_upper_1.4494177506_rad721.json; audited (results/audits.json). Phase-1 record 1.4529358988; published record 1.4546336567 (DIB+23, see published_upper).
upper.method: symmetry-reduced FW / primal-dual column generation with IPM masters, pool unions and exact re-solve; covering-saturated geodesic sets with dual-guided radius deformation

lower.exact_note: SDP3(M)/SDP1(M) = 1.4367003433346903 for a 97x97 integer matrix M with exact local bound 13921227005628453160441 (QuBowl) and rational 3D vectors.
lower.source: S. Designolle, T. Vertesi, S. Pokutta, Better bounds on finite-order Grothendieck constants, Phys. Rev. A 113, 022401 (2026), arXiv:2409.03739; supplemental DVP24_sup.jl lines 3-16 (data/sources/DVP24_sup_kg3_lines.jl); Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.13693164.
lower.use: proven lower bound: a certified upper bound below 1.4367 contradicts it and raises VERIFIER_ALARM

published_upper.exact_note: 1/v_low with v_low = eta^2 * nu2 * v0 = 0.6874583132193997, eta^2 = 0.9935 (406 rational vertices), nu2 = 1/(1+sqrt(7.5e-9)) = 0.999914, v0 = 173/250; printed 1/v_low = 1.4546336567186929. Stored value is truncated at 10 decimals (truncation makes a win harder).
published_upper.source: S. Designolle, G. Iommazzo, M. Besancon, S. Knebel, P. Gelss, S. Pokutta, Improved local models and new Bell inequalities via Frank-Wolfe algorithms, Phys. Rev. Research 5, 043059 (2023), arXiv:2302.04721 (v4 Oct 2026 erratum concerns marginals/multipartite only); supplemental DIB+23_sup.jl lines 7-19 (data/sources/DIB23_sup_lines1-20.jl). The explicit local model is not public ('provided upon request').
published_upper.method: 406 measurement directions for both parties (icosahedral geodesic polyhedron GP(9,0) from Conway operators, rationalized), Frank-Wolfe (BPCG) decomposition with 78747 deterministic strategies, residual absorbed by the l2-ball lemma, shrinking factor eta^2 for both parties.
